request: Redesign the Versions panel on C13 (891:86841) with Mobbin references, via /design:design-critique.
critique: The drawer was the only flush, square-cornered edge sheet in the workspace (376 x 844 at x1064 y56). It covered the right 40% of the 992-wide media viewer, cutting off the picture and the seek bar.

Nothing marked the version on screen, yet the footer said 'Edit this version'. With four rows and no selection, 'this' had no referent. The preferred version was not marked either, although 'Make preferred' was offered.
Lineage was muted text ('Warmer light · from v1'). In the flat list v4 (from v1) sat under v3 (from v2), so the branch the screen is named after was invisible.

Actions lived in two places: a ⋯ overflow on every row and three stacked full-width buttons (Primary, Secondary, Quiet) under the list. The buttons moved with list length and broke the one-toolbar pattern.
Every row repeated 'Desk ·'. A hidden meta line ('Viewing a version keeps your draft as it is.') was left in the frame.
Mobile B12 showed state as captions ('Latest version', 'Currently viewing') and duplicated close as a Done button.

references.pattern: The canvas shows the selected version; the history card has a timeline rail with a tinted selected row; Restore and Make a copy act on that selection.
Version history docked beside a media editor while the editor stays usable. This is the basis for a side panel instead of an overlay.
Dark right panel titled Versions with a close button; the selected version is the only emphasised card.
Restore sits with the selected version rather than in a detached stack.
One filled selected row plus a short state marker ('Current version').
Large visual previews make visual versions comparable. Rejected as a modal because it hides the conversation and draft.
Preview plus list plus one footer action named for what it does.
Same preview/list/footer structure; confirms the footer-action convention.
Vary and Upscale are bound to the image they affect; image tools treat variation as an action on a specific result.

direction: Versions is a right-hand card that twins the Conversation card: x1064 y64, 368 x 828, surface/panel, 1px border/default inside, radius/panel, space/16 padding. The media viewer narrows to 616 (x440), as the Editor stage already does beside right panels.

Rows draw the real branch. Each edit indents 24px under its parent; rails drop from the parent's picture, ├ continues to a later sibling, └ ends the branch, and ancestor rails pass through deeper rows.
The version in the viewer is the Selected row (surface/selected pill, as in Menu item). Selecting a row changes only the viewer. The preferred version carries a 'Preferred' marker.
Rows show the picture, the version ('v2') and what changed ('Warmer light'). There is no repeated item name, no 'from v1' caption and no per-row overflow.

One docked footer acts on the selected version: Make preferred, New variation, then the primary Edit vN last. When the selected version is already preferred, the first button reads Preferred with a check and is inert (no screen draws this yet).
Mobile (B12) uses the same rows and actions in its bottom sheet, with a Versions title beside the close button. Done and the status captions are removed.
